status: FIXED (this specific abort); no claim of full IGI playability

root_cause.summary: runtime/win32hle/ddraw.c desc_shape() treated every DDSURFACEDESC whose dwSize >= 124 as a four-byte-shifted variant and placed ddpfPixelFormat at +76. DDSURFACEDESC (108) and DDSURFACEDESC2 (124) actually share ddpf at +72 and ddsCaps at +104 (mingw-w64 ddraw.h). Retail IGI passes dwSize 124 and reads DDPF_RGB from +76 and dwRGBBitCount from +84 in its 0x50B4F0 conversion routine (test al,0x40 at 0x50B6E8; cmp 0x20/0x10 at 0x50B6FE/0x50B8F7; error branch 0x50BB62 pushes 'Invalid texture format' at 0x54EAD8). With the shifted layout the surface was created with bpp 63488 = 0xF800 (the RGB565 red mask read from +88) and GetSurfaceDesc returned dwFlags 32 (dwSize) at the address IGI reads as dwFlags.
guest_evidence: 0x50B5A5 rep movsd copies a 32-byte DDPIXELFORMAT from ebp-0x68 (= desc+0x48 = +72) into the desc's ddpf at ebp-0xe4
0x50B6E5 mov al,[ebp-0x64] = desc+0x4c = ddpf.dwFlags; test al,0x40; je 0x50B6EC -> 'Invalid texture format'
0x50BC00..0x50BD55: EnumTextureFormats callback accepts only DDPF_RGB formats with bitcount <= 16 and nonzero RGB masks; Unicorn confirms 11 of develop's 20 formats are accepted.
root_cause.fix: desc_shape() now uses the standard offsets for 108- and 124-byte descriptors and keeps the shifted layout only for the nonstandard 128-byte shape (wf.exe) and the old dwSize=0 signature fallback.

unicorn.result: For the format IGI selects, guest callback accepts it and the real check bytes take the success path 0x50B6FB; a zeroed PF takes 0x50B6EC (error). 32bpp entries are rejected by IGI's callback.
